call-site.source:
(require '[futon2.aif.mission-registry :as mr]
         '[futon2.aif.action-proposer :as ap]
         '[futon2.report.war-machine :as wm]
         '[futon2.aif.trace :as trace]
         '[cheshire.core :as json])
(defn private-value [sym] (var-get (ns-resolve 'futon2.report.war-machine sym)))
(let [loaded (mr/load-missions)
      alive (mr/open-missions loaded)
      candidates (vec (ap/propose mr/mission-enumerator-proposer {:missions alive}))
      idx ((private-value 'mission-doc-index))
      central ((private-value 'centrality-joint-map))
      cascade-path (or (System/getenv "FUTON_WM_STRATEGY_CASCADE") (private-value 'default-strategy-cascade-path))
      cascade ((private-value 'read-strategy-cascade) cascade-path)
      history (trace/recent-trace-records 12)
      capture (fn [opts]
                (with-redefs-fn {(ns-resolve 'futon2.report.war-machine 'mission-doc-index) (constantly idx)
                                (ns-resolve 'futon2.report.war-machine 'centrality-joint-map) (constantly central)
                                (ns-resolve 'futon2.report.war-machine 'read-strategy-cascade) (constantly cascade)}
                  #(wm/enrich-candidates-with-mission-value candidates history opts)))
      baseline (capture {})
      off (capture {:live-doability? false})
      on (capture {:live-doability? true})]
  (spit "/tmp/outer-selection-capture.json"
        (json/generate-string
         {:captured-at (str (java.time.Instant/now))
          :jvm {:java-version (System/getProperty "java.version")
                :classpath (System/getProperty "java.class.path")
                :futon3c-delta-resource (some-> (clojure.java.io/resource "futon3c/aif/mission_delta_t.clj") str)
                :environment (select-keys (into {} (System/getenv)) ["FUTON_WM_LIVE_DOABILITY" "FUTON_WM_VALUE_WEIGHTS" "FUTON_WM_STRATEGY_CASCADE"])}
          :loaded loaded :alive alive :candidates candidates :mission-doc-index idx
          :weights ((private-value 'mission-value-weights) {})
          :centrality-path (private-value 'forward-model-centrality-path)
          :centrality-raw central :cascade-path cascade-path :cascade cascade
          :history history :default baseline :explicit-false off :explicit-true on
          :default-equals-false (= baseline off)} {:pretty true})))
(shutdown-agents)

candidate-assembly.alive-rule: Exclude :complete, :inactive, :draft; :unknown remains eligible. No filesystem candidate synthesis.

call-site.isolation: No judge invocation, no serving JVM call, no environment flag modification. Both arms use frozen mission-doc index, centrality, cascade and trace inputs.

formula.rule: (central*w.central + strategic*w.strategic + phase-doability*w.doable + epistemic*w.epistemic) * completion-gate * operator-gate * non-progress-decay
formula.note: Reported :doable is already operator-gated; implementation blends phase-doability before multiplying gates. Lexical subject tie order is presentation only; tied values remain tied.
